Name: Speaking valley
Author: Dualityofsoul
Description:
[size=3][b]Note:[/b][b] [/b]Tested on 1.6.[b] [/b]This is my first mod ever. Bugs are to expected. Feel free to reach out with any issues. I'm more active on discord, and you can dm me if you want username: dualityofsoul [/size]

[b]Overview:[/b]Immersive mod that brings your Stardew Valley NPCs to life by giving them voices! With this mod, every character in the game can speak using advanced text-to-speech (TTS) technology from Azure and Elevenlabs. This enhancement transforms your gameplay experience, adding depth and personality to each interaction.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Voice Integration:[/b] Characters now speak their dialogue, utilizing the power of Azure and Elevenlabs TTS services.
[*][b]Customizable Voices:[/b] Assign unique voices to each NPC. Choose from a variety of male and female voices to match each character's personality.
[*][b]Voice Configuration:[/b] Tailor the pitch, rate, and style of voices for a more personalized experience.
[*][b]API Flexibility:[/b] Easily switch between Azure and Elevenlabs TTS services based on your preference.
[*][b]Dynamic Voice Selection: [/b]Automatically fetches and updates the available voices from Azure and Elevenlabs, ensuring you always have the latest options. (If you use GMCM)
[/list][b]How It Works:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Setup[/b]: Provide your Azure and/or Elevenlabs API keys, select your preferred TTS service, and configure the default voices for male and female characters.
[*][b]Customization[/b]: Use the in-game menu to assign specific voices to each NPC. Adjust their pitch, rate, and style for a unique sound.
[*][b]Interaction[/b]: As you interact with characters in Stardew Valley, their dialogue will be read out loud using the selected voice settings. This creates a more engaging and lively interaction with the game's characters.
[/list][b]Which service to use?
[/b][list]
[*][b]Azure: [/b]cheap, and fast, but worse quality. Practically free (I believe you get like 100k free tokens per month i have never had to pay for it.)
[*][b]Elevenlabs:[/b] Pricy, and good quality, but not as fast. Due to format limitations in SMAPI you must be atleast Creator tier or above (22$, and 100k tokens monthly)
[/list][b]Service Setup
[/b][list]
[*][b]Azure: [/b]Here is a quick [url=https://vitalpbx.com/blog/how-to-create-microsoft-azure-tts-api-key/]guide[/url] remember to add both the region, and the api key.﻿
[*][b]Elevenlabs:[/b][b] [/b]sign up for the free[b] [url=https://elevenlabs.io/]ElevenLabs[/url] [/b]account. Click on your profile in the lower left side > Profile + API key, and copy/paste it into the correct GMCM option.
[/list][b][size=4]
﻿ ﻿IMPORTANT!!! Never share, or show your api keys to anyone![/size][/b]
[b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Download the Mod[/b]: Obtain the latest version of Speaking Valley from Nexus Mods.
[*][b]Extract Files[/b]: Extract the contents to your Stardew Valley mods
folder.
[*][b]Configure Settings[/b]: Launch the game and navigate to the mod configuration menu to input your API keys after adding them close the GMCM menu, and open it again to populate the settings with the different voice options.
[/list][b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b]: Ensure you have the latest version of Stardew Valley installed.
[*][b]SMAPI[/b]: Install the latest version of SMAPI.
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b]: Strongly adviced. Dynamically adds the voice options. Extremely important for elevanlabs.
[/list]
